Configure nested Tesseract and PaddleOCR settings in a multi-backend pipeline

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', mime_type: 'text/plain', uri: 'https://example.com/text/report.txt'), { 'ocr' => { 'enabled' => false, 'pipeline' => { 'quality_thresholds' => {  }, 'stages' => [{ 'backend' => 'tesseract', 'priority' => 100, 'tesseract_config' => { 'enable_table_detection' => false, 'psm' => 6 } }, { 'backend' => 'paddleocr', 'paddle_ocr_settings' => { 'enable_table_detection' => true, 'model_tier' => 'server', 'use_angle_cls' => true }, 'priority' => 90 }] } } })
puts result.results[0].mime_type.inspect
puts result.results[0].content.inspect
```
